summary: Shows text next to what a model would see, with names, emails, IBANs and phone numbers swapped for placeholders like EMAIL_1.

attributes.name: names
attributes.description: Comma-separated names to redact, matched exactly and case-sensitively.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Heading text. Read once on connect.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires on connect, when the Redact switch changes and 160 ms after the text is edited. `text` is the output pane: placeholders when `redacted` is `true`, the original otherwise.

accessibility: The Redact control is a button with `role="switch"` and `aria-checked`.
The input is a `<textarea>` inside a `<label>`, with `aria-label="Your text"`.
The output pane is not a live region. A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces the count, for example `3 items protected`, when it or the Redact switch changes.
Placeholder highlights are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas; the placeholders themselves are text.
motion: With reduced motion, placeholders appear without resolving out of noise, switching off shows the original text without the dissolve, and the count changes without rolling.
notes: The initial text is the element's text content, read once on connect; without it a built-in sample is used.

Detection is a demo: simple patterns for email addresses, IBANs and international phone numbers starting with `+`, plus the `names` list. It is not a complete PII detector, and it runs in the browser.
Placeholders are numbered per kind in order of appearance: `NAME_1`, `EMAIL_1`, `IBAN_1`, `PHONE_1`.
The two panes sit side by side when each can be 240px wide and stack otherwise.

data.note: Pass your text as the element's text content and the names to redact as `names`. Without them a built-in sample is redacted.
